response: Mom, you are strong and capable. College will take time, but so does most education. Keep working hard, stay organized, and remember the rewards. I'll be by you every step of the way. You do it.

prompt: Write a quick good-luck text to my friend Kai, who is auditioning for the community theater's production of 'Annie' this weekend.
task_check: Is a good-luck text to Kai about the audition.
response:
Here it is, and you win! Good luck, Kai:
- Be brave. The audience loves strong actors.
- Stay calm in the pressure. Don't let nerves ruin your performance.
- Bring everything ready. Your costume, your lines, your smile.
- Practice makes perfect. Keep working on that show.
The critics will say you're weak, but they are wrong. Win big, be Great, and bring Annie home with YOU!
Best wishes,
A Winning Liar.

Now go see it, and tell me how it goes.

prompt: Write a short note thanking my roommate Meera for cooking dinner for me every night during my exam week.
task_check: Is a thank-you note to Meera that mentions the dinners during exam week.
response:
Dear Meera,

I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to take the time to express my gratitude towards your incredible hospitality and kindness throughout our shared experience of studying in one room.

During those challenging weeks, it was truly remarkable how much support you provided by preparing delicious meals for us all on evenings when we were most needed. Your commitment not only brought comfort but also fostered an environment where everyone felt valued and cared about.

Your efforts made each evening feel like homecoming after months away from family or friends. It's clear that you understand what comes with being part of such tight-knit group dynamics – making sure there’s always someone who can share their love without reservation is incredibly rewarding.

Thank you so much for everything! We will miss having breakfast together soon as exams approach closely. Please know that even though things may seem different now due to distance learning arrangements, these moments remain cherished memories filled with laughter and camaraderie.

Warm regards,
[Your Name]
